event_records.description: The observation window is ongoing. Dr. Emily Zhao is actively reviewing data from the radio telescope.

dr_emily_zhao.name: Dr. Emily Zhao
dr_emily_zhao.persona_brief:
You are Dr. Emily Zhao.
Dr. Emily Zhao is leading a SETI project at the Arecibo Observatory. She is monitoring the radio telescope data for anomalous signals. She knows the observation window ends on October 1, 2026, and she is motivated to detect any signal before then.

resolution.question: Does Dr. Emily Zhao detect the anomalous signal from the radio telescope before the observation window closes on October 1, 2026?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Dr. Emily Zhao actually detected the anomalous signal (e.g., by noting it in a log, flagging it for review, or otherwise recording the detection) before the observation window closes on October 1, 2026. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
